Preserving historic chimneys requires gentle, non-destructive cleaning methods and specialized historic tuckpointing with mortar formulations matched to period brickwork. Frequently Asked Questions in Fairmount, Fort Worth

How do I know if my historic chimney needs relining?

Many craftsman homes were built without flue liners or with thin clay tiles that have cracked. If mortar joints between bricks inside the flue have eroded, installing a stainless steel liner is the safest way to restore fireplace function.

Can you remove glazed creosote from my chimney?

Yes. We use specialized rotary tools and chemical treatments designed to safely break down stubborn Stage 3 glazed creosote without damaging the flue liner.
